key_insight: A PPO-based controller can coordinate battery, hydrogen, diesel, and grid exchange in a community microgrid to keep load service high while improving revenue and renewable utilization under uncertainty.
engineering_relevance: The study shows that reinforcement learning can serve as a practical EMS for hybrid renewable microgrids with coupled storage, offering a pathway to resilient low-carbon operation.
method: Formulated microgrid dispatch as an 11-dimensional Markov decision process.
Used PPO to learn continuous control of battery, diesel, and hydrogen actions; grid exchange was computed from power balance.
Evaluated on 8,760 hourly samples for a 1,000-household community in Rockhampton, Australia.
evidence_signal: On the annual test case, the policy achieved A$195,690.67 revenue, 91.2% renewable fraction, 99.77% load satisfaction, and 0.085 kg CO2/kWh under the stated boundary; under higher outage risk it still supplied 98.79% of demand.
watch_item: Performance is sensitive to renewable-profile variability, training stability, and the accounting boundary used for emissions and revenue.
paper_title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Energy Management for Hydrogen-Enabled Community Microgrids Under Uncertainty
